topics.title: Speedo Suits & Movie Mishaps
topics.summary: During the news segment, hosts discuss Tommy’s changing bathing suit habits and his physique. A couple who met on set for the movie ‘Far Out Man,’ married after mushroom-fueled nuptials two years prior, is introduced. Later, a teenager confessed to murdering his wealthy parents with a dumbbell and knife, sparking debate about parental control.

topics.title: Tommy and Shelby’s Unconventional Relationship
topics.summary: During filming, Tommy Chong and Shelby Chong develop a connection after she auditions for a role. They rehearse extensively, including intimate scenes, leading to their eventual romantic relationship. The details of when they become fully nude together are left ambiguous within the conversation.

topics.title: Stockbroker Interview with Tommy Chong
topics.summary: During an interview, the host questions callers about weight loss and introduces Tommy Chong and his wife Shelby. They discuss their Nutrisystem diets, Tommy’s stockbroking career, personal habits like eating pancakes for breakfast, and a disagreement regarding Cheech's departure from the band due to financial success.”}” id=

topics.title: Discomforting Public Displays of Affection
topics.summary: The broadcast centers around Shelby’s discomfort with Tommy's public displays of affection, prompting discussions about appropriate social behavior and referencing similar situations involving other couples. Participants question the norms surrounding intimate gestures while discussing magazines like Spin and expressing bewilderment at the situation.

topics.title: Radio Show Features Richard Belzer and Listener Commentary
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Howard Stern, Robin Quivers, and Richard Belzer discuss listener commentary about Bill Mazer’s appearance on Letterman, speculation regarding Stern's ratings, and personal insults. The conversation includes references to Satan and debates over various individuals, primarily focusing on the perceived negativity surrounding Howard Stern.”}  çocuğa. 160 words.}”

topics.title: Stern Dominates Morning Radio Ratings
topics.summary: Howard Stern’s radio show achieved a significant lead in winter 1990 ratings, surpassing the morning zoo according to Arbitron/Halstead research. The conversation centered on news events like German reunification and Ivana Trump while discussing soda preferences and playfully debating beverage ingredients.
